naslov: Pacers' Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) out at least 2 weeks
tekst:
Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton has a "mild" strained left hamstring and will miss at least two weeks, coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday.
"I don't think it is realistic that he'd play before that," Carlisle said of Haliburton, who is listed as week-to-week. "And then go from there."
Earlier in the day, Carlisle told 107.5 The Fan in Indianapolis that the Pacers had brought in a hamstring expert they've consulted with in the past to meet with their trainers, Haliburton and members of the front office before Wednesday's home game against the Philadelphia 76ers.
Haliburton played in the first four games of the season for Indiana -- including a back-to-back this past Sunday and Monday -- after he had missed 16 months while recovering from a torn Achilles suffered in the 2025 NBA Finals.
He acknowledged feeling "a little beat up" after Monday's game in Milwaukee before appearing on the injury report Wednesday.
Haliburton had been averaging 21.8 points, 9.5 assists and 4.5 rebounds on 52% shooting while playing 33 minutes per game to start the season.
He has dealt with injuries to his left hamstring before. In January 2024, Haliburton missed 10 of 11 games with the injury, returned for the rest of the season and then aggravated it during the playoffs and missed the final two games of the Eastern Conference finals against Boston.
Haliburton becomes the latest in an influx of star players sidelined with injuries to start the season, including Oklahoma City's Jalen Williams, Minnesota's Anthony Edwards and Toronto's Kawhi Leonard.
Injuries are also already beginning to pile up for Indiana, who had four of their five starters appear on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Sixers.
Ivica Zubac was already ruled out Wednesday's game with a left ankle sprain, while Carlisle said T.J. McConnell, who has yet to play this season, has a right hamstring strain and is expected to miss approximately one more week. Ben Sheppard tore his left meniscus and is expected to miss "months," per Carlisle, and Johnny Furphy had surgery on his right ACL.
Andrew Nembhard missed Monday's game in Milwaukee and is also listed as questionable heading into Wednesday's game with neck soreness.
The Pacers won 19 games, the fewest wins in a season in franchise history, while Haliburton was sidelined for the entire 2025-26 season.
